$scopeNote: html is a home-only brand (Emit.elm: own=[], all 16 TypedHtml.Component.* are HOME modules). No Build/components tier is derivable — real ceiling is 3 tiers: facts, core, elements (explosion Task 4). Unlike m3e (Task 1b), the barrel lives in the ELEMENTS tier, not core: home Component modules fuse their per-element type aliases (Attrs/ChildAdmittedBy/Roles) with their surface, and TypedHtml (barrel) references those types + delegates to them, so it has a hard elements->... dependency. Moving the barrel into core would require a shared home-emitter decoupling (emit TypedHtml.Internal.Types.<Home> in core + re-export from Component) that ALSO changes elm-typed-svg (the other home brand) — cross-brand generator work out of Task 4 scope and adjacent to the paused DAG-rework. See General.elm:33-52 / 194-218 (the deferred home-brand barrel decoupling).
